title: Map Markers and Collectables Dark Arisen Edition by Raze
author: Raze
summary: Optional Dark Arisen support with Spoils chest icons, trial-map Lost Rites markers, and independent base-game/DLC filters. DLC availability filtering starts off.

required_mods.name: REFramework
required_mods.notes: Required. Use a REFramework build compatible with the installed game update; this package does not include REFramework.

main_file.name: Map Markers and Collectables by Raze
main_file.description: Adds missing Spoils chests and a new icon, trial-map markers for 185 Lost Rites chests, and three quest chests. DLC filtering starts off; Lost Rites keeps its preview toggle. Dark Arisen optional. Requires REFramework.

publication_status: v1.5.1 candidate; native DLC acceptance pending.
